title: Words to read and colour: End shapes and taa marbutah (ة)
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: An-Nasr, Al-Kafirun and reading joined words
source: Written for quran/y1 lesson 29 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 29. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (End shapes and taa marbutah (ة)). Then trace and copy.

panels.title: End shapes
points: Some letters get a tail at the end: ـب
Look at the last letter carefully

panels.title: Taa marbutah: ة
points: Looks like ه with two dots

questions.q: Read «حَمَّالَةَ» going on and then stopping.
Pupil PDF: circle every ة and read each word stopping on it. The teacher listens to today's group.
questions.a: Words read with h at the stop.

questions.q: Extend: write ة on your whiteboard and hold it up.
When we stop on ة we say ...
questions.a: A) h. Stopping on taa marbutah: h.

questions.q: Think again: This letter (ة) looks like a haa with two dots. Is it a taa or a haa?
questions.a: It is taa marbutah: we say 't' when we keep going and 'h' when we stop.
